product_one_liner.value: Koppla provides collaborative construction scheduling and project-control software for general contractors, planners, developers, architects, and construction teams to plan and coordinate building projects.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies its construction-sector audience and scheduling/risk-reduction benefits; product page describes collaborative construction scheduling.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page presents project and enterprise license options, although pricing is quote-based.

named_customers.notes: All names appear on the company's references page.

employee_band.notes: Company page says more than 30 staff and lists 38; Tracxn search result gives 41 employees as of August 2026.

hq_location.notes: The company's legal imprint lists its address in Potsdam, Germany.

founded_year.notes: About page says founded in 2020; Tracxn independently records 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains marketing, product and construction-industry informational content; no two posts demonstrate engineering-authored details of product architecture, infrastructure, ML implementation or similar technical build topics.

public_docs.notes: The company homepage links a public Help Center; the support site is available for product assistance/documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page and open posting found list a Founder’s Associate GTM/RevOps/Growth role, not an AI, ML or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The company AI page describes an AI-supported product-import feature but does not name a model/provider; the security center also does not identify one.

compliance_certs.notes: The security center names ISO/IEC 27001. GDPR is also mentioned there, but it is a regulation rather than a certification from the provided list; TISAX is outside the requested list.

last_funding.notes: Koppla announced a €6 million seed round in May 2025; $6.8 million is the reported USD equivalent.

raised_18mo.notes: Most recent identified round was announced May 19, 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025? Correction: May 19, 2025 is within 18 months of November 9, 2026. Therefore the correct value is true.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Accessible current careers/job-board information shows a Founder’s Associate GTM/RevOps/Growth role, not a role titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index includes the April 28, 2026 announcement of the new multi-project overview in Koppla, within the six-month window beginning May 9, 2026? Correction: April 28 precedes the window. The most recent potentially launch-related post evidenced is not within the six-month window; the September post is informational, not a launch. False based on readable blog index.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available company page identifies founders but does not provide a full, dated team roster or evidence sufficient to verify executive arrivals/departures during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The accessible public help center and references page do not identify CRM or sales/marketing systems.
